newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease signs Bluewater syndicate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease signs Bluewater syndicate.

text.p: Property developer and financial services group Lend Lease Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a A$750 million syndicate of investors for its Bluewater retail complex at Kent in southern England.

Lend Lease said the syndicate consisted of the property investment units of Lloyds Leasing Ltd and Barclays Mercantile Business Finance Ltd, as well as the Royal Bank of Scotland Plc leasing arm Royal Bank Leasing Ltd. It said the syndicate purchased a 999 year lease at Bluewater.

Lend Lease also said it had signed a forward sale agreement with The Prudential Assurance Company Ltd who will, on completion, acquire a 999 year leasehold interest for 15 percent of Bluewater's income.
Bluewater is due to open in March 1999, with an expected value of more than A$1.4 billion.-Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
